title: Eddie Vinson and Tom in Algiers
summary: Asked about Eddie Vinson, Love describes him and Tom living near the Navy Yard gate in Algiers where the group practiced daily.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I think we only have a couple minutes left. Can you tell us anything about Eddie Vinson? Because naturally he's dead and we'll never learn much about him, but people like you could tell us a little about him.
He was a good musician. He could play pretty well. When I was a kid when I first met him, you see, him and Tom were always together. They lived in the first house down that land.
John Soxland, John Soxland they call it.
Well, that's where we used to practice. Not once a week, every day.
That's over in Algiers. Over in Algiers. Is it what they call down the coast there?

Down the coast, right at the Navy Yard gate, that west gate. It's right across the street. They got a little church on the corner. And they got a big house back in there with reed canes all around. You can't see it. It's falling down. They got a fellow living there, a rich man. They call him Mr. Ward.
